notes:
Speed up server-region discovery with offline geolocation and continuous results.

- Resolve known Roblox datacenters locally and use the official AWS geolocation feed.
- Include the DB-IP City Lite database inside the executable for other public IP addresses.
- Use the external geolocation API only when local data cannot resolve an address.
- Show each completed region immediately instead of waiting for a batch of six servers.
- Use up to six parallel Roblox address requests and reduce concurrency after rate limiting.
- Pause when enough matches are found, without waiting for a slower server to finish.
- Preserve region/player filters, cancellation, cache and update notifications.

Roblox address discovery still requires an authenticated session and remains subject to Roblox limits.
The installer is larger because it now includes offline IP-to-city data.

Data: DB-IP City Lite (https://db-ip.com, CC BY 4.0), official AWS geofeed, and community Roblox datacenter references from BTRoblox. IP-based locations are estimates.
